# NDP GitHub Label Scheme

Labels used for issue tracking. Apply via GitHub UI or `gh label create`.

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| bug | d73a4a | Bug report |
| implementation | 0075ca | Implementation tracking for planned features |
| enhancement | a2eeef | Enhancement or improvement |
| air | c5def5 | Air quality domain |
| dp | bfdadc | Data platform domain |
| fe | d4c5f9 | Feature engineering domain |
| ops | fef2c0 | Operations/tooling domain |
| ml | f9d0c4 | ML/predictions domain |
| al | e99695 | Alerts domain |
| db | c2e0c6 | Dashboards domain |
| sparc:refinement | fbca04 | SPARC refinement phase |
| sparc:completion | fbca04 | SPARC completion phase |
| P0-critical | b60205 | Critical priority |
| P1-high | d93f0b | High priority |
| P2-normal | fbca04 | Normal priority |
| in-progress | 0e8a16 | Currently being worked on |
| blocked | e4e669 | Blocked by dependency |
| needs-review | 7057ff | Needs user review |
